steps.say: Here is the machine from the outside: a door, a display, a knob and a start button.
Switch it on, and the display wakes up.
Now look inside. The drum sits in a tub, held by springs, and a motor turns it by a belt.
And down in the corner is the drain pump. It empties the tub after every wash.
Put the cover back, close the door and start a cycle, to see the pump work.
The drum fills, washes, then drains. That is the pump doing its job.
